s: to disappoint (displease by not fulfilling an expectation)
enttäuschen.et: Late 18th century, from ent- (“un-, dis-”) + täuschen (“to deceive”), a calque of French détromper (“to disillusion”), which had earlier been borrowed as detrompi(e)ren (now obsolete).

s: to expose, to unmask, to uncover
